title: Error: 'import' and 'export' may appear only with 'sourceType: module', When running sls deploy
body:
### Are you certain it's a bug?

- [x] Yes, it looks like a bug

### Is the issue caused by a plugin?

- [X] It is not a plugin issue

### Are you using the latest v3 release?

- [X] Yes, I'm using the latest v3 release

### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [X] I have searched existing issues, it hasn't been reported yet

### Issue description

running a deploy throws an Error: 'import' and 'export' may appear only with 'sourceType: module'.

Trying setting "sourceType" to "module" and it didn't work.

### Service configuration (serverless.yml) content

```yaml
service: nest-serverless-lambda

plugins:
 - 'serverless-plugin-typescript'
 - serverless-plugin-optimize
 - serverless-offline
 - serverless-webpack

provider:
 name: aws
 runtime: nodejs14.x

functions:
 oa-staging-backend:
   handler: packages/backend/src/app/lambda.handler
   events:
     - http:
         method: any
         path: /{any+}
```

sls deploy --verbose --debug "*"

comments.body: @basselabbara this looks as problem related to one of the used plugins. Please report at given plugin repository
@ahmadissa I already had to do it that way and it worked so I created an issue on the plugin's issue page. So far no response so I guess I'm gonna have to move on without optimize.

If you want to use axios while using optimization, you can exclude the relevant modules from optimization.
ex:
```
custom:
  optimize:
    external:
      [
        'axios',
        'form-data',
        'combined-stream',
        'delayed-stream',
        'mime-types',
        'mime-db',
        'asynckit',
        'proxy-from-env',
        'follow-redirects',
      ]
    includePaths:
      [
        'node_modules/axios',
        'node_modules/form-data',
        'node_modules/combined-stream',
        'node_modules/delayed-stream',
        'node_modules/mime-types',
        'node_modules/mime-db',
        'node_modules/asynckit',
        'node_modules/proxy-from-env',
        'node_modules/follow-redirects',
      ]
```

satisfaction_conditions: Identification of which plugin is causing the 'sourceType: module' error
A working solution to deploy without the module error
A way to use optimization while avoiding the module error
Compatibility between axios and the serverless optimization plugin

_classification.category: Can be dockerized without any issue

title: `npm run test-ci` fails with  lib/classes/PluginManager.test.js
body:
# Bug Report

## Description

When I run `npm run test-ci` with the latest commit aba4e09c7be7e1c89b14728428f0f1a3bf9ccbbb, it fails and shows following message:

```
  105 passing (8s)
  1 failing

  1) PluginManager
       #loadAllPlugins()
         should throw an error when trying to load unknown plugin:

      AssertionError: expected [Function] to throw 'ServerlessError' but 'TypeError: Cannot read property \'realPath\' of null' was thrown
      + expected - actual

      -TypeError: Cannot read property 'realPath' of null
      +ServerlessError
      
      at Context.it (lib/classes/PluginManager.test.js:710:74)
      at process._tickCallback (internal/process/next_tick.js:61:11)



lib/classes/PluginManager.test.js failed

npm ERR! code ELIFECYCLE
npm ERR! errno 1
npm ERR! serverless@1.54.0 test-isolated: `mocha-isolated`
npm ERR! Exit status 1
npm ERR! 
npm ERR! Failed at the serverless@1.54.0 test-isolated script.
npm ERR! This is probably not a problem with npm. There is likely additional logging output above.

npm ERR! A complete log of this run can be found in:
npm ERR!     /Users/akito/.npm/_logs/2019-10-12T07_00_32_589Z-debug.log
npm ERR! code ELIFECYCLE
npm ERR! errno 1
npm ERR! serverless@1.54.0 test-ci: `npm run prettier-check-updated && npm run lint-updated && npm run test-isolated`
npm ERR! Exit status 1
npm ERR! 
npm ERR! Failed at the serverless@1.54.0 test-ci script.
npm ERR! This is probably not a problem with npm. There is likely additional logging output above.
```

Commit 050cb90684c03559fd484c89fb13ab380b3c263a may be related to this issue.
When I run the same command with the previous commit, 4d9006bcdf783f96ca89c4901947c7159ea64121, it gets success.
author: kdnakt

comments.body: @kdnakt ensure to update dependencies with `npm install` (error is like you've pulled new changes but didn't update the dependencies)
@medikoo Thanks for your advise, I got success after running `npm install`!

satisfaction_conditions: A solution that resolves the test failure in PluginManager.test.js
Instructions for properly synchronizing dependencies after pulling new code changes
An explanation of why the test was failing despite having the latest code

_classification.category: Can be dockerized without any issue
